answers.core:
Its 100% useful when using subviewports, as the current workflow of using a separate scene to edit stuff outside the viewport doesnt take into account the viewport size/ratio.
A scene cant know anything about its parent.

Advantage is to edit stuff with a proper subviewport size and save it on the same scene.
answers.workaround: I believe its 100% useful when using subviewports and used as often as using viewports.
